title: A true champion
html:
Last night I watched Scott Dixon on ‘This is your Life’. It was maybe a bit too soon to have him on there as he still has a lot of racing to go, but what an inspiration.

Scott has known what he wanted to do, since he was a kid, and has gone for it. There were some who might have laughed when he put his Sentra on the roof and thought ‘that's’ why 13 year olds aren't allowed to race’, but it didn't worry him and he wanted to prove himself even more after that.

His drive, determination and confidence has drawn in everyone from his parents, to his initial shareholders, to his team, to believe he could be the best. Their faith has paid off handsomely.

He’s a good (maybe not all the time) Kiwi kid who is the sort of hero New Zealand's kids should be looking up to, not just to get into motorsport but, for his professionalism, drive, demeanor and focus. He is a true champion in every sense of the word.

Scott reminds me that when you are passionate about something and really want it, people will turn up, and things will occur, that will make it happen for you.
